description: District Secretariat - Gampaha - Annual Feast of the Our Lady's Ragama Lanka Basillica Church - 2022
categorisation: This gazette announces a religious festival (Annual Feast of Our Lady's Ragama Lanka Basilica Church) and references regulations under the Pilgrimages Ordinance. The content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any specialized categories (4-9) such as land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. It falls under miscellaneous administrative announcements related to cultural/religious events.
